summary: HUTCHMED filed a Form 6-K on May 22, 2026, to notify the SEC of a press release announcing clinical data presentations at the 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting. The filing covers results from studies of savolitinib, fruquintinib, and surufatinib in various cancers, including a pivotal Phase II study of savolitinib in gastric cancer meeting its primary endpoint. No special-situation corporate transaction (acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, etc.) is disclosed. This is a routine regulatory filing of clinical trial data by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
